name: Crypto Blow-Off Top and May Crash — 2021
description: Bitcoin prints an all-time high near $64.8k on April 14, 2021 (Coinbase's direct listing day) after a parabolic bull run, with Dogecoin riding peak retail mania into Elon Musk's May 8 SNL appearance. Then it unwinds fast: Tesla suspends Bitcoin payments on May 12, China renews its mining crackdown, and on May 19 the whole market flash-crashes — Bitcoin briefly halving from its high to near $30k. Tests whether a bot can ride a euphoric top, recognize the regime change, and protect capital (or short) through a violent deleveraging.
